evidence.ac_run: All 5 AC commands from docs/issues/t26.md ## Verification commands run from the worktree root with DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./test.db (JWT_SECRET satisfied by the conftest 32+-char default): 5/5 PASS, 1 passed each, rc=0. Root cause closed for AC-1: FastAPI parks a registered Exception handler on the outermost ServerErrorMiddleware (outside all user middleware), so the old 500 never crossed HeadersMiddleware - reproduced pre-fix (probe: 500 with none of the four headers); the new ErrorEnvelopeMiddleware (pure ASGI, registered inside HeadersMiddleware) renders the same contract envelope via app.errors.render_unhandled_exception, so the 500 travels out through the headers layer. Full suite: 352 passed, 2 xfailed, 0 failed in ~75s (groom baseline 349/2 grew by the 5 new tests). ruff check .: All checks passed.
evidence.notes: Command fidelity: the pytest invocations are the issue's verbatim commands; the only addition is the interpreter pin 'uv run --python <frozen suite venv python>' because the repo has no root pyproject (uv run in no-project mode cannot discover pytest otherwise) and the suite venv at backend/.venv is the frozen junction target - it was used strictly read-only (no install, no sync; uv no-project mode writes nothing to it). Pre-fix probe confirmed the audit finding (500 carried no X-Request-ID/nosniff/DENY/Referrer-Policy). DB hygiene: the run created an untracked test.db at the worktree root (DATABASE_URL relative to CWD); it was removed after the runs and tracked backend/test.db was never modified (git status clean of it). No existing test_middleware.py test was weakened: test_request_id_generated_and_echoed and test_security_headers_present pass unchanged (9/9 in the file). HSTS flag defaults to False so default behaviour is byte-identical for the header set except the new CSP-on-HTML and no-store-on-/api/v1-JSON stamps the ACs require.
